answer: The burnisher rubs the sheet with the stone until it takes a shine, and the shine must be even. Paper rag packer chase warrant is the rubbing: a warrant rag packers hold after packing room trials. The quartz is the first rub, made at the bench; the lagoon is the last, made before the sheet is stacked, and the lotus is the bench itself, worn smooth by rubbing. A cheat must rub 53 false sheets and stack 53 false stones.
